title: API returns 503 after deployment
description: The application API returns HTTP 503 after the latest deployment. Restarting the service temporarily resolves the issue.

title: Database connection pool exhausted
description: Requests fail because the database connection pool reaches its maximum size during peak traffic.

title: Login fails after password reset
description: Users cannot log in after resetting their passwords. The authentication service returns an unexpected error.

title: Service unavailable after release
description: The backend becomes unavailable after a new release. Application logs show repeated upstream connection failures.

title: Slow dashboard queries
description: The dashboard loads slowly because several database queries take too long to complete.

title: HTTP 502 errors from API gateway
description: The API gateway returns HTTP 502 when forwarding requests to backend services. The issue started after a configuration change.

title: Deployment causes health checks to fail
description: New application instances fail readiness and liveness checks after deployment, causing the orchestrator to restart them repeatedly.

title: Database queries time out during peak hours
description: SQL queries exceed the configured timeout during high traffic. Query duration increases as concurrent database load rises.

title: Connection leaks exhaust database connections
description: Database connections are not returned to the pool after requests complete. The pool eventually reaches its maximum capacity.

title: Password reset link is expired
description: Users receive an expired or invalid token message when opening password reset links from their email.

title: Login returns unauthorized after password change
description: Authentication requests return HTTP 401 after users change their passwords, even when the new credentials are correct.

title: Dashboard page takes several seconds to load
description: The analytics dashboard renders slowly because it retrieves large result sets and performs expensive aggregations.

title: CPU usage spikes after application release
description: Application CPU utilization increases sharply after a release, causing slower responses and occasional failed health checks.

title: Payment charged but order remains pending
description: Customers are charged successfully, but the order service continues to display the order as pending.

title: Payment gateway returns intermittent errors
description: Checkout requests intermittently fail with gateway errors when communicating with the external payment provider.

title: Duplicate payment transactions
description: Some customers are charged twice after retrying checkout when the first payment request appears to time out.

title: Email notifications are not delivered
description: Account and order emails are missing because the notification worker fails to process queued messages.

title: Notification queue backlog keeps growing
description: Queued notification messages accumulate faster than workers can process them, delaying email delivery.

title: Uploaded files return access denied
description: Users receive permission errors when downloading uploaded documents from object storage.

title: File uploads fail for large documents
description: Uploads of large files fail when the request exceeds the configured body-size limit or times out.

title: Service discovery returns stale backend addresses
description: Requests are routed to outdated backend instances because the service registry retains stale endpoint information.

title: TLS certificate expiration breaks API requests
description: Clients cannot establish secure HTTPS connections after the API certificate expires.

title: Cache misses increase database load
description: A rise in cache misses causes more requests to reach the database, increasing response times and database utilization.

title: Container restarts repeatedly after deployment
description: Application containers enter a restart loop following a release because the process fails during startup.

title: API rate limit rejects legitimate requests
description: The API returns HTTP 429 for valid clients because rate-limit counters are shared incorrectly across requests.
